diagnosis: The distributed trace diagnostics route allows team members to fetch Sentry breadcrumb logs for any trace_id without validating that trace_data.workspace_id == team_member.workspace_id. Internal database SQL queries and query parameters from other workspaces are exposed in breadcrumbs.
exploit_request:
GET /ops/traces/trc_9a8820f1e/exception-breadcrumbs HTTP/1.1
Host: monitor.cloudplatform.net
Authorization: Bearer <member_token>
